_comment: Drives the SCHEDULED job only. Any ticker typed into local/index.html is fetched live and need not be listed here.
_etf_note: FMP's etf-holder endpoint returns 403 on the free tier, so these currently fail and the ETF panel stays empty. That is reported, not hidden.
_metals_note: Spot metal, NOT GLD/SLV. GLD holds roughly 0.09oz per share and SLV roughly 0.92oz, so a gold/silver ratio built from share prices is wrong by about 10x. Those factors also drift downward as expense ratios erode the metal backing, so no fixed multiplier fixes it. Spot avoids the problem entirely.

model._comment: Walk-forward validation cannot run in a browser, so it stays here. Each symbol adds roughly ten seconds.
